title: Offer B&O for Indiana to block red split
description: Offer B&O for Indiana to block red split. The railroad sweetener is acceptable because Indiana completes red. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd like to buy Indiana Avenue for $200. Let me know if you're interested!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring Indiana gives me a monopoly on the red set (Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois). This will allow me to build houses and increase rent dramatically. Offering $200 is a fair price given my cash reserves.
